title: ACS Actividades de Construccion y Servicios SA - proposed acquisition of Hochtief Aktiengesellschaft
acquirers: ACS Actividades de Construccion y Servicios SA

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: ACS currently holds 29.98% interest in Hochtief Aktiengesellschaft and is proposing to increase its interest.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the proposed acquisition in the context of the design, construction and operation of water infrastructure; and the design, installation and operation of tolling systems. However, the ACCC did not consider it necessary to form a definitive view on market definition.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC concluded that the proposed acquisition would not be likely to substantially lessen competition in any market. In reaching this conclusion, the ACCC had regard to the following factors: - The minimal overlap between the merger parties; and - The presence of other competitors.
